_comment: Demo module. Extends `default` and pulls in the `tiefling-pack` library to demonstrate the full composition story: inherited base content + library overlay + per-module override. Open in the editor to see: human → overridden (from this module), tiefling → inherited (from the library), dwarves/elves/etc. → inherited (from default).
title: Demo Module
description: A tiny playable module that extends `default`, pulls in the `tiefling-pack` library, and overrides the Human race description to show off the module composition system.
author: Matt
